title: Built this Match-3 game while I was waiting for my coffee to brew lol
author: Santiago_Lawliet
selftext:
Yo! My coffee was literally still hot by the time I finished "coding" this.

I decided to test the **Plutusgg** studio to see if I could actually talk a logic-heavy Match-3 game into existence. Usually, AI dev is a buggy mess, but I just prompted the neon aesthetic and the grid mechanics, and it actually... works?

It's a direct web build, no signup or anything. Give it a spin and let me know if it feels like "AI jank" or if the juice is actually there:

**Link:**[https://www.plutus.gg/aigame?g=699cbd4a87207c00222f41d7&env=dev](https://www.plutus.gg/aigame?g=699cbd4a87207c00222f41d7&env=dev)

The wild part was the **Plutusgg** AI handling the particle effects and animations on the fly. Is "vibe coding" the new meta, or am I just tripping? Roast the mechanics in the comments!

comments.author: Santiago_Lawliet
comments.body:
Honestly speaking, this is just the beginning or more like the first iteration. Will try to make something new.   
You guys got any suggestions ? T-T

replies.body: I wish it was my site - but it is not. I am in touch with their team though. And just like others I am also a user who thought the app is really cool, and worth sharing
